scripts.build: npm run build:store && npm run build:control && npm run build:studio && node scripts/check-integrated-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @hendy/admin-web && npm run typecheck --workspace @hendy/studio-web && npm run typecheck --workspace @hendy/core-utils && npm run typecheck --workspace @hendy/shared-types
scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace @hendy/core-utils && npm run test --workspace @hendy/studio-web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
